event.text:
A table whose rows do not all reach the end:

| tool | what it does | cost |
|------|--------------|------|
| read |
| grep | walks the tree | 4 |
| bash | runs a command | 40 | and one cell too many |

A narrow table in a wide terminal:

| a | b |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2 |

A bare URL the renderer has to find for itself: https://example.com/plain and one
in angle brackets <https://example.com/bracketed>, which are not the same thing.
Entities are resolved in prose — AT&T becomes AT&T — but left alone inside code, where `&` and `<div>` stand as they are written.
